title: SalesAI
tagline: Create a sales agent for your business from the first engagement to the final transaction
description:
Enable any human expert to create a custom product and have it sold by an AI agent, or create an agent based on their expertise and instantly monetize it with Circle Developer Wallets.

Features
🤖 AI-powered sales agents that understand your product
💳 Seamless payments with Circle Developer-Controlled Wallets
🔗 ARC Testnet integration for gasless transactions
💰 USDC payments with instant settlement
✨ Beautiful, mobile-first UI
how_its_made:
Architecture
This project consists of two main parts:

Frontend (React + Vite + TypeScript)
AI chat interface for product sales
Checkout flow with Circle wallet integration
Real-time transaction monitoring
Backend API (Node.js + Express)
Circle Developer-Controlled Wallets integration
Payment processing on ARC Testnet
Transaction status monitoring
